description: Harvard’s Center for Green Buildings and Cities publishes notebooks used to prepare HouseZero monitoring data. The repository contains separate processing notebooks for two annual periods and multiple measurement groups. The inspected load-processing example filters quality flags, converts time zones, aggregates hourly values and applies gap and outlier rules before exporting CSV files. Source access is public and free under Apache 2.0. Coverage follows the June 2022–May 2024 HouseZero monitoring campaign. The routines can prepare observations for building simulation comparisons with model-energyplus. A caveat is that the examples contain local Windows paths, positional file selection and manually specified missing-data intervals. Some photovoltaic gaps are set to zero, which must remain distinguishable from measured zero output. There is no repository README, and no notebook was executed.
